title: The site switcher's per-site submenu opens from its row down and stays inside the viewport
steps: S1: In vendor/tracy/dsh-better-sidebar run: ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/tracy-browser.spec.tsx -t "places the per-site submenu"
expect: Hovering a site row in the browser tab's site switcher opens its submenu with collision-aware placement: inline bottom 'auto' and a top of at least 12px, never above the viewport.
evidence: On cowork.tracy.site (09/10/2026) the submenu of the first site row sat at top -35px and of the second at -11px, cutting off Live Edit.
fence: BrowserTabTitle passes collisionAvoidance to DSH's Menu
